name: resurank
description: Score how well your resume matches a job description, locally. No API keys, nothing uploaded.
long_description: Wraps the same hybrid (semantic + keyword TF-IDF) scoring engine used by the ResuRank desktop app and exposes it to Claude Desktop as a single resurank_score tool. The resume is loaded from a local file path you choose at install time; the embedding model (~25 MB) is downloaded on first run into the standard Hugging Face cache and re-used across sessions.

tools.name: resurank_score
tools.description: Score a resume against a job description; returns a 0–100 match score, matched/missing keywords, critical gaps, and a breakdown.

resume_path.title: Resume file
resume_path.description: Local path to your resume (.pdf, .docx, .txt, or .md). The server reads this file on every score call and auto-reloads when you save edits.
